blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Ten graduates from Cebu-based universities made it to the top 10 of the November 2026 Customs Brokers Licensure Examination (CuBLE). Al-Yasser Dimaronsing Mangontawad from the University of Cebu (UC) and Seanne Kyle Debulosan Trapero from the University of the Visayas (UV) led the Cebu pack at 6th place with a 94.25 percent rating. Crys Aldrin Cañales Aton from the University of Cebu in Lapu-Lapu and Mandaue (UCLM) clinched the 7th place after posting 94 percent rating.
